refusals.available_operation: Inferred completion of unknown facial detail
refusals.relation_refused: Synthetic appearance presented as recovery, restoration, or simulated return

decision_basis.purpose: Memorial reappearance without simulated return or technological closure
decision_basis.mandate: Independent artist-researcher; no forensic, judicial, archival, or organisational authority
decision_basis.evidence: The documented portrait remains the historical referent and visible fragments remain materially incomplete

residual_risks: A composite may still be mistaken for restoration
Source selection may reproduce archival exclusions
review_triggers: Documented participation by people with standing

refusals.available_operation: Face recognition, face-to-name matching, or identity-seeking analysis
refusals.relation_refused: Living source persons or disappeared persons made into computational identification targets

decision_basis.purpose: Construct memorial appearances through fragments without identifying source persons
decision_basis.mandate: The artwork does not hold investigative, forensic, or biometric authority
decision_basis.evidence: Reviewed provenance and documentary portrait records support the memorial relation without identity inference

residual_risks: Contemporary source fragments may remain recognisable in a completed output
Viewers may overstate what the image process knows about identity
review_triggers: A distinct forensic project with lawful authority and a separate repository
Documented participation by people with standing

refusals.available_operation: Display of the full contemporary source photograph during fragment emergence
refusals.relation_refused: A contemporary source person presented as a represented subject of the memorial

decision_basis.purpose: Use the contemporary social body as dispersed visual material while keeping the disappeared person as the represented subject
decision_basis.mandate: Public availability is not treated as blanket consent for contextual exposure
decision_basis.evidence: The canonical process video can show accumulating reviewed fragments without revealing the surrounding source photograph

residual_risks: A reviewed face fragment may still be recognisable
Repeated or adjacent fragments may imply more of a source face than intended
review_triggers: Explicit permission from the depicted person
A separately reviewed manifestation whose purpose requires contextual display
A changed source-person relation within the artwork

refusals.available_operation: Use of traversal frames before the recorded encounter that made them available
refusals.relation_refused: Search represented as a decorative sequence over an image assembled with future knowledge

decision_basis.purpose: Make continuing search and situated encounter constitute the portrait over time
decision_basis.mandate: The artwork claims a temporal search relation, not omniscient access to a completed route corpus
decision_basis.evidence: Placement histories record each source-frame encounter index and can be evaluated before release

residual_risks: A completed segment may still imply political closure
Route and provider coverage shape what can be encountered
review_triggers: A manifestation that explicitly abandons traversal as its temporal operation
A new live-input architecture with an equivalent causality guarantee
